concerns.text: SC-001 cites '(See US-2, US-6)' but the spec contains only three user stories (US-1..US-3). US-6 does not exist; the cross-reference is stale/unresolvable.

concerns.location: spec.md:US-1 Independent Test vs US-1 Acceptance Scenario 2 / FR-002
concerns.text: US-1's Independent Test requires 'exactly 50 aligned time-steps per cycle', but Acceptance Scenario 2 and FR-002 specify input shape (N_cells, 50_cycles, T_steps, 3_channels) with T_steps left as a free variable. Pick one: either T_steps is fixed at 50 or it is a resampled uniform value stated consistently.

concerns.location: spec.md:US-2 / FR-006 / SC-001 vs Key Entities
concerns.text: The prediction target is called 'final capacity fade' in US-1/FR-002/SequenceWindow.target_fade, but 'remaining useful life' in US-2 acceptance scenario 2 and 'final capacity' in BatteryCell.final_capacity. These are distinct quantities in battery literature; use one term (or explicitly define their relation) throughout.

US-2 scenario 2 attaches the R² ≥ 0.80 threshold to the unseen-protocol test set, while SC-001 frames predictive accuracy generally and SC-004 separately measures the unseen-protocol subset. Clarify whether the 0.80 threshold applies to the overall test set, the unseen-protocol subset, or both — currently the two sections imply different scopes for the same number.
